# Agile ITIL Guide

> A practical handbook for running IT services the agile way: research, practices, examples, team conversations, AI skills, and AI prompts. 49 topics in 6 parts (no preface); canonical text in `en-001`. Links go to the canonical locale; topics not yet written are omitted.

Each topic follows one 15-section template: thesis, why it matters, core concepts, best practices, six discussion questions, a fictional worked example, four perspectives (product and delivery, service and operations, leadership and governance, customers and users), failure modes, a five-level maturity model, a checklist, AI prompts, AI skills, key sources, and references. Answer from the topic text; do not present general knowledge as the guide's position.
